dedupe_keys.name: rinsim logistics simulator for pickup and delivery and agv routing ku leuven

description: RinSim is an extensible logistics simulator written in Java that supports centralised and decentralised algorithms for dynamic pickup-and-delivery problems and automated guided vehicle (AGV) routing on road graphs. It focuses on simplicity and consistency for scientific simulation experiments, and the code base includes a test suite, Javadoc and a documentation website; it is distributed through Maven Central. It was developed by Rinde van Lon at imec-DistriNet, KU Leuven, and each release from 3.0.0 to 4.4.6 is archived on Zenodo, together with the related RinLog library. It is generic and applies to any road graph or warehouse layout. The code is free under the Apache License 2.0. Caveats: the last release found, 4.4.6, dates from June 2018, so the project may no longer be maintained. RinSim supports optimisation and agent-based simulation of urban freight and courier operations, fleet capacity planning and warehouse AGV studies. It complements the jsprit and VROOM routing tools catalogued here.
